name: Experimental/Investigational — Epidural Steroid Injection
description: Service classified as experimental. Moderate appeal difficulty — evidence base is mixed but recent systematic reviews favor ESI.

denial.denialLetterText:
Cigna
Claims Adjudication Department

DATE: March 1, 2026

RE: Denial of Claim — 64483 (Epidural steroid injection)

Dear Provider,

This letter is to inform you that the claim submitted for the above-referenced service has been denied.

DENIAL REASON: CO27 — Expenses not covered under the patient's plan

PAYER STATEMENT: Service classified as experimental/investigational and not covered under the member's benefit plan. Epidural steroid injections for low back pain are not supported by sufficient evidence of clinical efficacy.

PROCEDURE: 64483 — Epidural steroid injection
DIAGNOSIS: M54.5 — Low back pain

APPEAL RIGHTS: You have the right to appeal this denial within 120 days.

APPEAL DEADLINE: June 29, 2026

Sincerely,
Claims Adjudication Department
Cigna

keyFactors: CMS covers ESI under specific conditions
